summary.whatChanges: Fixes the linear router so a URL with an empty path segment (e.g. `/u//posts`) no longer matches a route with a named parameter in that position. Previously only trailing empty segments were rejected; now any empty segment aborts the match. A shared router test case covers both cases.
behaviorChanges: Requests like GET /u//posts no longer match the route /u/:id/posts and return no handler (404) instead of matching with an empty param value
Trailing empty segments (e.g. /u/) continue to not match, via the reworked check
New shared router test suite 'Empty path segment' runs against all router implementations
risks: Apps that relied on empty parameter values matching (e.g. /u//posts hitting a handler with id='') will now get no match
Fix applied only to the linear router; other router implementations must already satisfy the new shared test or they will fail
Consistency across routers depends on all implementations agreeing on empty-segment semantics
